intro_zh: 本課學習過去簡單式的規則動詞，動詞加 ed 表示過去做過的事，常見時間詞有 last year、yesterday 等。透過旅行、國家與節慶的情境，練習說出自己做過的事。
can_do: 能使用過去簡單式說明自己去年做過的事。
能描述參加節慶的經驗，使用 -ed 動詞。
能閱讀簡短的旅行故事並回答相關問題。

sentences.en: Last year, Lily visited her grandmother in Taipei by MRT.
sentences.zh: 去年，莉莉搭捷運去台北拜訪她的祖母。

sentences.en: She took a bus to the museum and waited for the Dragon Boat Festival parade.
sentences.zh: 她搭公車去博物館，等待端午節遊行。

sentences.en: During the trip, she saw a red envelope gift for Chinese New Year.
sentences.zh: 在旅行中，她看到紅包禮物，為中國新年準備。

sentences.en: She celebrated the Moon Festival with her family and ate moon cake.
sentences.zh: 她和家人一起慶祝中秋節，吃了月餅。

sentences.en: Last Halloween, Lily drove a car to a farm to pick a pumpkin.
sentences.zh: 去年萬聖節，莉莉開汽車去農場挑南瓜。

sentences.en: On the way home, she saw a big pumpkin and decided to fly a kite.
sentences.zh: 在回家的路上，她看到大南瓜，決定放風箏。

sentences.en: She waited in line for a ride on the carousel.
sentences.zh: 她排隊等待旋轉木馬的遊樂設施。

sentences.en: On Christmas Eve, she visited Santa Claus at the mall and got a gift.
sentences.zh: 聖誕前夕，她在商場拜訪聖誕老人，收到禮物。

sentences.en: She hopes to travel again next year.

grammar_points.explain_zh: 規則動詞的過去式通常在動詞原形後加 -ed。依據詞尾的不同，有四種常見的拼寫方式：直接加 -ed、詞尾有 e 去掉 e 再加 -d、子音 + y 改為 i 再加 -ed、以及重音閉音節需雙寫最後一個子音再加 -ed。
table: 詞尾有 e，去掉 e 再加 -d
子音 + y 改為 i 再加 -ed
重音閉音節，雙寫最後一個子音再加 -ed

grammar_points.explain_zh: 過去簡單式常搭配表示過去的時間詞，例如 yesterday（昨天）、last year（去年）、last week（上週）。這些時間詞放在句子的開頭或結尾，幫助說明動作發生的時間。

examples.en: I visited my grandmother last year.
examples.zh: 我去年拜訪了我的祖母。

examples.en: We waited for the parade yesterday.

dialogue.title_zh: 情境對話：去年參加節慶

lines.en: Last year, I traveled to Taipei to visit the Dragon Boat Festival.
lines.zh: 去年，我去台北參觀端午節。

lines.en: We waited for the parade for two hours.
lines.zh: 我們等了兩小時看遊行。

lines.en: I cycled along the riverbank and watched the boat race.
lines.zh: 我沿著河邊騎腳踏車並觀看了龍舟賽。

lines.en: After the race, we enjoyed zongzi and smiled a lot.
lines.zh: 賽後，我們享受了粽子並笑得很開心。

lines.en: Last week, I traveled to Kaohsiung to celebrate the Moon Festival.
lines.zh: 上週，我飛往高雄慶祝中秋節。

lines.en: We walked around the night market and liked the lanterns.
lines.zh: 我們在夜市走走走，喜歡了那些燈籠。

sentences.en: Yesterday, she waited for the bus at the station.
Last year, they celebrated Christmas with their family.
sentences.zh: 去年，他們與家人一起慶祝聖誕節。

sentences.en: Last week, he visited his grandparents in Tainan.
sentences.zh: 上週，他拜訪了台南的祖父母。

sentences.en: Yesterday, we walked around the night market and liked the lights.
sentences.zh: 昨天，我們在夜景市場走走走，喜歡了那些燈光。

sentences.en: Last year, the school organized a trip to the museum.
sentences.zh: 去年，學校組織了一次參觀博物館的旅行。

sentences.en: Last week, she cleaned her room and looked for an old gift.
sentences.zh: 上週，她打掃了房間並尋找了一份舊禮物。

sentences.en: Yesterday, they played soccer in the park after school.
sentences.zh: 昨天，他們在放學後在公園踢足球。

sentences.en: Last year, I received a red envelope during Chinese New Year.
sentences.zh: 去年，我在中國新年期間收到了一個紅包。

grammar: 動詞加 -ed 表示過去做過的事，常搭配 last year、yesterday 這類時間詞。

mcq.q: Yesterday I ______ for the bus. (等待)
Last year they ______ Chinese New Year. (拜訪)
Yesterday we ______ for the MRT. (等待)
Last year they ______ the Dragon Boat Festival. (拜訪)
Yesterday she ______ for the bus. (等待)
Last year they ______ the Moon Festival. (參觀)
Last year they ______ for the MRT. (等待)

She gave me a ____ for my birthday.（她送我一份禮物作為生日禮物）

Please ____ here for five minutes.（請在此等候五分鐘）
We went to the park ____.（我們昨天去了公園）
The cat is ____ the box.（貓在盒子裡）
She sat ____ the chair.（她坐在椅子上）
He bought a present ____ his friend.（他為朋友買了禮物）
They went ____ the museum.（他們去了博物館）
The gift is ____ the table.（禮物在桌子旁）

This is the way to the station.
